title: Lena and the Asset
author: Freya Galloway
blurb: Freya Dunmore, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
